about: Gear modifier -> the official trade site's stat ids, for searches the player clicks. Built by tools/refresh/gear_trade_stats.mjs from Exiled Exchange 2's stats.ndjson (MIT, https://github.com/Kvan7/Exiled-Exchange-2). mods[id]: one [row, firstRange, ranges] per line of the modifier's text (null: no trade stat); ranges 0 = no value filter, 2 = the average of two. rows[i].ambiguous: the ids cover more than one stat (local and global), so the search asks for either.
